comment: rootDir='..' (repo root) is the D9 shared-schema decision: the worker imports the SINGLE src/db/schema.ts (no worker-local copy → no drift). Output lands under dist/ mirroring the repo layout (dist/worker/src/index.js imports ../../src/db/schema.js → dist/src/db/schema.js). next-auth is a TYPE-ONLY devDep — schema.ts's `import type` from next-auth/adapters is erased at runtime. Railway builds from the REPO-ROOT context so ../src resolves.
